verdict.rationale: Conta Simples documents per-purpose cards with set limits assigned to responsible people (docs-20, docs-27) and adjustable VCN ceilings and controls (docs-15), so card limits can cap spending. It also lists an approvals area (docs-25) and cost-center classification and analysis (docs-7, docs-26). However, nothing shows budgets allocated to teams or projects and then enforced: cost centers serve only for classifying spend, and approvals appear tied to payments rather than budgets. Missing for 10: explicit team/project budget objects, cost centers linked to card limits or budget caps, approval workflows that enforce budget thresholds on card spend, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
